title: SUBTRACKS: four lanes on a track (test build)
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: After the Tonverk's Subtracks: every audio track gets four lanes sharing its one voice. Lane 1 is the track itself; lanes 2-4 are 16-step lanes, each with its own sample, TUNE, STRT, LEV, FREQ, RESO and PAN, played as locks. A hit cuts the one before; two lanes on one step, the lowest plays. TRK twice opens the SUB page: UP/DOWN picks the lane, the trig keys set its steps, knobs A-G its settings (-- follows the track), FUNC + trig 1-4 mutes a lane, NO closes. 0.1 tests the playback: the lanes are shared by all patterns and not saved yet. Needs seq-events.
